This role ensures secure, reliable, high-performance communication between distributed applications using IBM, Apache, and open-source messaging technologies. The engineer also manages complex scheduling environments and contributes to automation, observability, and continuous improvement of mission critical integration systems.
Key Responsibilities
  • Messaging Platform Administration (IBM MQ, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ): Install, configure, upgrade, and secure messaging platforms. Create and manage messaging artifacts: queue managers, queues, topics, channels, listeners, security settings, retention policies. Implement HA/DR, clustering, replication, and multi-node failover strategies. Performance tuning: throughput optimization, message persistence, batch sizes, connection pools, buffer/log tuning. Monitor health metrics using dashboards (Prometheus/Grafana/ELK/Splunk) and handle incidents proactively. Troubleshoot message flow failures, dead-letter queues, consumer lag, stuck messages, and network bottlenecks.
  • Integration Engineering (IBM IIB / ACE): Design, develop, and deploy message flows using ESQL, Java, mapping nodes, REST/SOAP connectors, MQ/Kafka nodes. Build and manage BAR files, integration nodes, servers, policies, and environment overrides. Implement integration security: TLS/mTLS, OAuth/JWT, Basic Auth, certificate management. Troubleshoot and optimize integration flows for latency, throughput, parser efficiency, and memory footprint. Participate in CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, unit testing, and environment migrations.
  • IoT Telemetry Messaging (IBM MQXR / MQTT): Configure and support MQXR Telemetry listeners, MQTT topics, subscriptions, and QoS policies. Secure MQTT clients using TLS certificates, access control, and throttling policies. Monitor MQTT client connections, sessions, retained messages, and message routing to backend MQ systems.
  • Workload Automation (IBM TWS / IWS): Install, upgrade, configure, and administer TWS/IWS masters, controllers, and agents. Build job streams, calendars, dependencies, event triggers, and SLA monitoring. Troubleshoot job failures, optimize schedules, and implement recovery workflows. Integrate workload scheduler with MQ, REST APIs, databases, file systems, and enterprise applications.
  • Security, Governance Compliance: Implement end to end security for messaging and integration technologies: TLS/SSL, mTLS, JAAS, CHLAUTH policies, RBAC, OAuth/SASL. Perform auditing reporting for security compliance frameworks. Ensure platform hardening, certificate rotation, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Automation, DevOps Observability: Create automation scripts (Shell, Python, PowerShell) for deployments, housekeeping, and monitoring. Build IaC templates (Ansible, Terraform) for consistent provisioning. Integrate platforms into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI). Maintain dashboards for real time system health and SLA adherence.
  • Documentation Collaboration: Create runbooks, SOPs, operational guidelines, and architectural diagrams. Work closely with application teams, architects, network, cloud, and security teams. Participate in on call rotation and production support responsibilities.

  • IBM MQ (Distributed / MQ Clustering / Security)

  • RabbitMQ (AMQP, mirrored/quorum queues, federation/shovel)

title: Systems Engineering Specialist - Tanium
jobDescription:
Job Title
Systems Engineering Specialist Tanium Deployment Endpoint Support (Grade 8)
Location
Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
Experience
69 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with hands-on specialization in Tanium platform deployment and support.
Job Summary
This role is responsible for deploying, configuring, and supporting the Tanium platform across enterprise endpoint environments. The engineer will manage Tanium infrastructure components, onboard endpoints, configure and administer Tanium modules, and provide L2 support for platform and endpoint issues. Working under senior guidance, the role contributes to platform stability, endpoint visibility, and operational efficiency across the managed device fleet.
Minimum Education
Graduation / Engineering degree
Key Responsibilities
  • Deploy and configure Tanium Server, Tanium Module Server, Zone Proxies, and Tanium Client across enterprise environments.
  • Execute Tanium platform deployments following defined architecture standards, deployment runbooks, and organizational guidelines.
  • Manage Tanium Client deployment at scale across Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints using GPO, SCCM, Intune, and script-based methods.
  • Configure Tanium Zone Proxies for DMZ and remote site endpoint connectivity and visibility.
  • Set up and configure Tanium modules post-deployment including Tanium Patch, Deploy, Interact, Inventory, Comply, and Connect.
  • Manage Tanium platform SSL certificates, authentication configurations, and RBAC role assignments during and post-deployment.
  • Execute Tanium platform upgrades, module updates, and hotfix deployments following change management procedures.
  • Validate post-deployment platform health - server connectivity, client registration rates, module functionality, and data accuracy.
  • Document deployment configurations, architecture decisions, and post-deployment validation results for knowledge transfer.
  • Support proof-of-concept (POC) and pilot deployments for new Tanium modules or platform expansions.
Tanium Platform Administration Support
  • Administer day-to-day Tanium platform operations including server health monitoring, client connectivity, and module performance.
  • Monitor Tanium Server and Module Server health, disk utilization, database performance, and service availability.
  • Manage Tanium Client health across the endpoint fleet - identify and remediate non-reporting, unhealthy, or disconnected endpoints.
  • Configure and maintain Tanium computer groups, management rights, and content set assignments for organized endpoint management.
  • Develop and maintain Tanium saved questions, sensors, and packages for endpoint data collection and targeted actions.
  • Manage Tanium action approvals, deployment targeting, and action history reviews for audit and governance compliance.
  • Support Tanium RBAC configuration - user roles, permissions, computer group access, and content set boundaries.
  • Troubleshoot Tanium Client registration failures, SSL errors, and connectivity issues between clients and Zone Proxies.
  • Perform routine Tanium platform maintenance - database cleanup, log management, index optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Handle L2 escalations for Tanium platform issues, documenting root cause findings and resolution steps.
Tanium Module Operations
  • Operate and support Tanium Patch for enterprise patch deployment - configure patch lists, maintenance windows, and deployment targeting.
  • Manage Tanium Deploy for software distribution - create software packages, define deployment configurations, and monitor rollout success.
  • Use Tanium Interact for real-time endpoint querying, ad-hoc diagnostics, and targeted endpoint actions.
  • Administer Tanium Inventory for software and hardware asset discovery, tracking, and reporting across managed endpoints.
  • Support Tanium Comply operations - scan endpoints against CIS and STIG benchmarks and report compliance posture.
  • Configure Tanium Connect for data export integration with SIEM, ITSM, and reporting platforms.
  • Monitor module-specific dashboards and act on non-compliant or at-risk endpoint findings within defined SLA windows.
  • Assist in developing Tanium Comply benchmark customizations and tailored compliance profiles under senior guidance.
Endpoint Onboarding Client Management
  • Manage end-to-end Tanium Client onboarding for new endpoints, sites, and organizational units.
  • Coordinate endpoint onboarding activities with infrastructure, desktop, and server teams to ensure full platform coverage.
  • Validate client registration, sensor data accuracy, and module functionality for newly onboarded endpoints.
  • Manage client configuration files, tanium-init.dat distribution, and client version standardization across the fleet.
  • Support decommissioning and offboarding of endpoints from the Tanium platform following defined procedures.
  • Track onboarding progress and report endpoint coverage metrics to senior engineers and management.
Scripting Automation
  • Develop PowerShell and Batch scripts to automate Tanium Client deployment, health checks, and remediation tasks.
  • Create Tanium packages and action scripts for remote automated fixes, software installations, and configuration changes.
  • Write Tanium Relevance-based sensors for custom endpoint data collection and targeted group scoping.
  • Assist in developing Tanium REST API integrations for reporting automation and ITSM ticket workflows under senior guidance.
  • Maintain a library of tested Tanium packages, scripts, and deployment runbooks for team reuse.
Secondary Platform Support
  • Working knowledge of SCCM / Microsoft Intune for hybrid endpoint environments where Tanium coexists with Microsoft tooling.
  • Support Tanium Client deployment leveraging SCCM and Intune as distribution mechanisms for managed endpoints.
  • Assist in troubleshooting endpoint management conflicts between Tanium and co-existing SCCM/Intune tooling.
Collaboration Service Excellence
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security, desktop, and server teams to support Tanium deployment and operational activities.
  • Participate in change management processes for all Tanium platform configuration changes and deployments.
  • Contribute to Tanium knowledge base articles, deployment SOPs, and operational runbooks.
  • Escalate complex platform issues to senior Tanium engineers with detailed diagnostic information and troubleshooting notes.
  • Support audit and compliance activities by providing Tanium platform configuration documentation and endpoint coverage reports.
  • Assist in mentoring Grade 7 engineers on Tanium platform fundamentals and endpoint support best practices.
Required Skills
  • Tanium Deployment Administration
  • Tanium Patch/Deploy/Interact/Inventory/Comply/Connect
  • Tanium Client deployment via GPO, SCCM, Intune, and PowerShell scripting
  • Tanium sensor, package, and saved question development
  • Tanium RBAC
  • Tanium Relevance Language
  • PowerShell and Batch scripting for Tanium automation
  • Tanium Connect integration with SIEM and ITSM platforms
  • Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoint management fundamentals
Preferred Qualifications
  • Tanium Certified Administrator or equivalent hands-on certification
  • Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or SCCM certification
  • ITIL Foundation certification
  • Experience supporting enterprise environments of 5,000+ endpoints
  • Familiarity with CIS Benchmark and STIG compliance frameworks
  • Experience with REST API integrations for endpoint management automation

title: Senior Network Engineer (SD-WAN)-L2
jobDescription:
As a Senior Network Engineer - (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
Key Responsibilities
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure.
  • Handle Routing Switching operations across LAN/WAN environments.
  • Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions.
  • Manage and support firewall environments including policy creation, troubleshooting, and security enforcement.
  • Monitor network performance and ensure high availability of network services.
  • Perform incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution within SLA timelines.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for network-related escalations.
  • Maintain network documentation and operational procedures.
  • Participate in rotational shifts for continuous network support.
Mandatory Skills
  • Strong hands-on experience in Routing Switching configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in SD-WAN.
  • Hands-on experience with HPE SD-WAN (Silver peak )solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with FortiGate Firewall or Palo Alto Firewall.
  • CCNA Trained.
  • Hands-on experience with Aruba Wireless Solutions.
  • Minimum 5 years of overall networking experience.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, OSPF, STP, and network security concepts.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skill
Good to Have
  • Experience with Fortinet SD-WAN, Versa SD-WAN, or Cisco SD-WAN, Viptela, Meraki
  • CCNA Certified.
  • Experience managing and configuring Aruba Switches.
  • Exposure to enterprise network monitoring and management tools
Desired Candidate Profile
  • Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Willingness to work from the Mangalore office and in rotational shift
Workplace type: On-site

  • 3+ years of hands-on dbt Core experience - model layering, macros, tests, incremental materializations
  • Any number of years of Airflow experience - DAG authoring, task dependencies, and incorporation with scheduling tool
  • 5+ years of Python experience, including production use of parallelism and batch data processing

title: MCP and Enterprise Integration Engineer
jobDescription:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
We are currently seeking a MCP and Enterprise Integration Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
MCP and Enterprise Integration Engineer
Model Context Protocol | Enterprise tools and APIs | Secure, reusable integration
Position details
  • Number of positions: 1
  • Level: Senior Individual Contributor
  • Primary locations: Hyderabad or Noida preferred; exceptional onshore candidates may be considered
  • Target / alternate titles: MCP Engineer; AI Integration Engineer; GenAI Integration Engineer; Enterprise API Engineer - AI; Tooling Engineer - Agentic AI; Backend Integration Engineer
  • Core keywords: Model Context Protocol, MCP server, MCP tools, tool schemas, JSON Schema, APIs, microservices, enterprise integration, OAuth2, OIDC, mTLS, service accounts, identity, authorization, secrets, Java, Python, TypeScript, ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB, event integration, observability
  • Recruiter red flags: Only consumed MCP tools; no server implementation; generic middleware profile with no agent or LLM understanding; weak identity and authorization knowledge; no production API ownership; no contract testing or observability.
Role purpose
Design, build, secure, and operate MCP servers, tools, and enterprise-integration components that allow agents to interact safely with business systems, data platforms, knowledge sources, and operational services. The role will establish reusable tool contracts and integration patterns that can be extended by internal teams as new ecosystems and use cases are added.
Client and delivery context
The first MCP server and tools create the pattern for broader scale. Once the scaffolding is proven, internal teams should be able to add tools with lower effort and risk.
The client already applies strong review and security scrutiny to production MCP services. The engineer must produce implementation and evidence that can pass established controls.
Integrations may span service management, identity, configuration data, knowledge bases, data platforms, business applications, and custom internal APIs.
The engineer must understand both agent behavior and traditional enterprise integration; tool exposure must not bypass business rules, authorization, or auditability.
Primary ownership
  • MCP server architecture and implementation, tool and resource definitions, schemas, discovery, versioning, lifecycle management, and developer documentation.
  • Secure connectivity to enterprise systems, including authentication, authorization, secrets, service identities, network controls, and data access enforcement.
  • Reliable adapters, APIs, events, and integration services that expose controlled capabilities to agents.
  • Tool-level observability, testing, error management, performance, resilience, and reusable implementation patterns.
Key responsibilities
  • Design and implement MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, schemas, and capability-discovery patterns aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Translate enterprise API and workflow capabilities into narrowly scoped, well-described, validated, and auditable agent tools.
  • Implement OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, service identities, delegated authorization, role or attribute-based access, secrets management, and least-privilege controls.
  • Build connectors and adapters for enterprise platforms, knowledge systems, databases, event streams, file repositories, and custom services.
  • Implement input validation, output normalization, idempotency, retries, timeouts, rate limits, circuit breakers, pagination, caching, and consistent error contracts.
  • Prevent unsafe tool use through explicit schemas, server-side business rules, authorization checks, confirmation patterns, and restricted action surfaces.
  • Create contract, integration, security, performance, and end-to-end tests for MCP tools and downstream dependencies.
  • Instrument tool calls with tracing, metrics, structured logs, audit events, latency, failure reasons, and dependency health.
  • Support deployment, release management, version compatibility, rollback, incident troubleshooting, and production support for MCP services.
  • Publish reusable SDKs, templates, tool-development guidance, examples, and onboarding documentation for internal teams.
Must-have candidate profile
  • 7+ years of backend, API, middleware, platform, or enterprise-integration engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience building MCP servers or equivalent agent tool and function-integration layers; direct MCP experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong development skills in Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or a comparable backend language.
  • Deep understanding of API design, JSON Schema, contracts, microservices, distributed systems, asynchronous integration, and error handling.
  • Strong identity and security experience, including OAuth2, OIDC, tokens, service accounts, mTLS, authorization, secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise applications, data systems, knowledge platforms, or operational tooling in production.
  • Experience with automated testing, API gateways, containers, CI/CD, logging, tracing, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of LLM tool calling, agent risks, prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, and server-side control requirements.
Preferred experience
  • Experience integrating with platforms such as ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB systems, collaboration suites, document repositories, search platforms, or data catalogs.
  • Experience with API management, service mesh, event streaming, queues, webhooks, and enterprise integration platforms.
  • Experience developing reusable SDKs, connector frameworks, internal developer platforms, or integration templates.
  • Experience with fine-grained authorization, policy engines, data entitlements, consent, or delegated user access.
  • Experience supporting multi-tenant, high-volume, or highly regulated integration services.
  • Experience with agent evaluation, trace analysis, and tool-use simulation.
Indicative technology exposure
MCP SDKs and specifications; Python, Java, TypeScript/Node.js, or Go; REST, gRPC, GraphQL, events and queues; JSON Schema/OpenAPI; OAuth2/OIDC/mTLS; API gateways; containers/Kubernetes/serverless; secrets and identity platforms; ServiceNow, SailPoint, CMDB, enterprise search, data platforms, or similar systems; OpenTelemetry and API monitoring. Equivalent technologies are acceptable.
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each clients needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form.

Role Summary
We are seeking a consulting-oriented Senior Consultant / Lead Consultant Source-to-Pay Solution Architect to join our team in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. This role will align procurement business processes with enterprise technology platforms, helping organizations transform sourcing, contracting, procurement, invoicing, and payment operations through scalable architecture, process standardization, and digital enablement.
The ideal candidate will bring deep functional expertise across the S2P lifecycle, strong architecture capabilities, and hands-on experience with leading procurement platforms and ERP integrations. This role requires a client-facing consultant who can translate business requirements into practical solution designs, guide implementation teams, and act as a trusted advisor to procurement, finance, and IT stakeholders.
Job Responsibilities
  • Partner with client stakeholders across procurement, finance, IT, and operations to understand business objectives, process gaps, and transformation priorities.
  • Design end-to-end Source-to-Pay solution architecture spanning Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Lifecycle Management, Contract Lifecycle Management, Procure-to-Pay, Accounts Payable, and payment-related processes.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable functional and technical solution designs aligned with client operating models and enterprise architecture standards.
  • Define integration architecture between S2P platforms and ERP, finance, supplier, and third-party systems using APIs, middleware, EDI, and cXML-based approaches.
  • Lead architecture discussions, solution blueprinting, and design governance across S2P transformation and implementation programs.
  • Support platform implementation activities across tools such as SAP Ariba, SAP S/4 Procurement, Sirion, Oracle Procurement Cloud, Ivalua, Jaggaer, or GEP.
  • Drive process standardization, automation, and best practice adoption across sourcing, supplier onboarding, contract management, purchasing, invoicing, and payment workflows.
  • Ensure procurement controls, compliance requirements, approval structures, and auditability are built into the solution design.
  • Define and support data architecture considerations related to supplier master data, catalog data, contract data, and procurement transactions.
  • Develop high-level and low-level design artifacts, solution flows, integration designs, and implementation guidance for delivery teams.
  • Advise clients on cloud architecture, SaaS platform adoption, scalability, security, and performance optimization within S2P environments.
  • Identify opportunities to enable digital capabilities such as AI/ML for spend analytics and supplier risk, RPA for invoice and workflow automation, and analytics dashboards using tools like Power BI or Tableau.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including business analysts, architects, engineers, implementation partners, and client leadership to ensure successful delivery.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders including CPO, Finance, and IT leaders by providing structured recommendations, risk assessments, and solution guidance.
  • Contribute to consulting assessments, transformation roadmaps, implementation planning, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Job Requirements Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in procurement, Source-to-Pay, ERP, or related enterprise transformation domains.
  • 35 years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, or solution leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading or supporting Source-to-Pay transformation and platform implementation programs.
  • Experience working in consulting, advisory, or client-facing delivery environments is strongly preferred.
Soft Skills
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage procurement, finance, IT, and executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent communication, consulting, and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and solution evaluation capability.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional programs and influence teams in complex client environments.
Nice to Have
  • Certifications in S2P platforms such as SAP Ariba, Sirion, or Oracle Procurement Cloud.
  • Experience with ESG, supplier risk, or third-party risk tools.
  • Exposure to global procurement compliance, controls, and regulatory environments.

Strategic mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and concepts into actionable insights for business leaders.
Proficiency with compensation tools and platforms ( e.g. HRIS).
Experience in post-merger integration or transformation environments is a strong advantage.
A global mindset and passion for building reward programs that support a diverse and high-performing workforce.

We are currently seeking a SAP BTP Developer to join our team in Hyderabad.

Role Overview
This role is aligned to a large global SAP S/4HANA transformation program delivered using SAP Activate, a Greenfield+ implementation approach, SAP S/4HANA RISE PCE, Fit-to-Standard principles, and a Clean Core delivery model. The role is expected to support formal design, build, test, deploy, cutover, hypercare, and knowledge transfer activities across a multi-wave enterprise implementation. The position requires strong documentation discipline, close collaboration with functional and technical workstreams, and the ability to operate within structured governance, change control, validation, and deliverable approval processes. The SAP BTP Developer will design, build, test, deploy, and support SAP Business Technology Platform-based applications, services, workflows, APIs, and extensions for a global SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role will focus on side-by-side extensibility and clean-core aligned solutions that complement SAP S/4HANA without modifying the core. The developer will collaborate with SAP S/4HANA technical developers, Fiori developers, integration developers, solution architects, functional teams, security teams, and testing teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reusable BTP solutions. The candidate must understand how SAP BTP fits into the broader extensibility strategy across Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based services, and side-by-side extensions.
Responsibilities
  • Design and develop SAP BTP side-by-side extensions that support approved business process gaps while preserving clean-core architecture.
  • Collaborate with SAP S/4HANA technical teams and architects to determine whether requirements should be fulfilled using standard SAP functionality, Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, RAP-based service exposure, or SAP BTP side-by-side extensibility.
  • Develop BTP applications, services, APIs, workflows, and integration components using approved enterprise architecture patterns.
  • Consume SAP S/4HANA released APIs, CDS-based services, OData services, RAP services, and business events in BTP applications and extensions.

Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced Data / Retrieval Engineer to design, build and operate enterprise-grade data ingestion and retrieval capabilities for AI agents and knowledge-search platforms.
The role will focus on transforming enterprise business knowledge into secure, trustworthy and citation-backed context. The engineer will be responsible for improving retrieval quality, grounding, data readiness, latency and operational cost across Retrieval-Augmented Generation and enterprise-search solutions.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the data ingestion and retrieval ecosystem supporting enterprise AI agents.
  • Design and build scalable ingestion pipelines for structured, semi-structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop indexing solutions using:
    • Vector retrieval
    • Keyword search
    • Hybrid retrieval
    • Semantic search

  • Build reranking, grounding and citation-generation mechanisms to improve response accuracy and traceability.
  • Convert business documents and knowledge assets into reliable, contextual and reusable data products.
  • Implement access-aware retrieval based on users, roles, entitlements and source-system permissions.
  • Apply metadata filtering, document lineage, freshness controls and source-level traceability.
  • Establish appropriate controls for:
    • Personally Identifiable Information
    • Sensitive and confidential data
    • Data retention
    • Security and governance evidence
  • Partner with AI-agent, MCP, application and platform engineers to improve retrieval relevance, grounding, latency and infrastructure cost.
  • Create retrieval evaluation datasets, including representative queries, expected sources and relevance labels.
  • Define and monitor retrieval-quality metrics such as REMAIL_ADDRESS, PEMAIL_ADDRESS, Mean Reciprocal Rank, NDCG, citation accuracy and groundedness.
  • Develop monitoring dashboards, alerts and operational runbooks for retrieval quality, data freshness and model or index drift.
  • Troubleshoot production issues related to ingestion failures, missing documents, stale indexes, access-control leakage and poor retrieval relevance.
  • Optimise retrieval pipelines for scalability, availability, observability and performance.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering, backend engineering, search engineering, machine learning engineering or knowledge-platform development.

    • Vector databases

    • Reranking

Data Platforms: Vector databases, relational databases, document stores

jobDescription:
About J-PAL South Asia:
J-PAL is a global research centre working to reduce poverty and fight climate change by ensuring that policy is informed by scientific evidence. Anchored by a network of over 1,100 researchers at universities across the world, J-PAL works with governments, NGOs, and donors to generate evidence and scale effective solutions. J-PAL South Asia, based at the Institute for Financial Management and Research (IFMR) in Chennai, leads J-PAL s efforts to advance evidence-informed policymaking across the region. The office works with over 20 state governments and multiple central ministries in India, across sectors including health, education, labour markets, energy, environment, climate action, and gender.
J-PAL South Asia hosts CLEAR South Asia, the Regional Centre for Learning on Evaluation and Results, coordinated by the World Bank s Independent Evaluation Group (IEG). CLEAR South Asia is a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative (GEI), a global network of institutions dedicated to strengthening evaluation capacities in developing countries.
About the Training Vertical:
The Training vertical at J-PAL South Asia works to strengthen monitoring, evaluation, data, and evidence-use capacities and systems. The team delivers open-enrolment and customised courses, technical advisory services, fellowships, knowledge products, and long-term institutional capacity-building engagements with governments and other development partners. J-PAL South Asia also hosts CLEAR South Asia, a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative.
Role Summary:
J-PAL South Asia seeks a data-focused Training Manager / Senior Manager to lead the design and delivery of capacity-building programmes that help public institutions and social-sector organisations improve how they collect, manage, analyse, govern, and use data for decision-making and evaluation. The role sits at the intersection of applied data analytics, monitoring and evaluation, adult learning, and institutional strengthening.
The successful candidate will translate real-world administrative and programme data challenges into rigorous, practice-oriented curricula and advisory engagements. They will lead technical content development, facilitate training for diverse audiences, manage partnerships and programmes, mentor team members, and help build a portfolio of data-capacity initiatives that is closely connected to J-PAL s research and policy mission.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Data-focused training strategy and portfolio development
    • Support the development and execution of the Training vertical s strategy for data and evidence capacity building, translating priorities into annual plans, milestones, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
    • Contribute to thought leadership on the evolving role of data systems, AI, and digital tools in M&E practice, helping government partners navigate opportunities and risks as these technologies reshape how evidence is generated and used in public systems.
    • Identify opportunities for new courses, technical assistance, fellowships, and institutional partnerships focused on administrative data, data governance, analytics, and evidence use.
    • Build a coherent pathway from foundational data literacy to advanced applied analytics, tailored to the needs of government officials, M&E practitioners, researchers, and implementing organisations.
    • Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, donor engagement, and the stewardship of existing grants.
  • Curriculum and technical content development
    • Lead the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of curricula, teaching materials, exercises, datasets, manuals, toolkits, and knowledge products on data-focused topics.
    • Develop applied learning content using realistic government and social-sector datasets, while ensuring confidentiality, ethical use, and appropriate data protection.
    • Create training modules for partners on topics such as data quality assessment, data cleaning and validation, reproducible workflows, administrative data systems, data visualisation, dashboarding, data governance, responsible data use, and the use of data for monitoring and evaluation.
    • Translate technical concepts into accessible and engaging learning experiences for audiences with different levels of quantitative proficiency.
    • Keep content current by drawing on J-PAL research, field experience, partner needs, and emerging good practices in public-interest data systems.
  • Training delivery and facilitation
    • Lead and facilitate high-quality in-person, virtual, and blended training programmes for government and non-government stakeholders.
    • Teach technical sessions and oversee hands-on labs using relevant software such as Excel, Stata, R, Python, SQL, or data-visualisation tools.
    • Design assessments, assignments, capstone exercises, and feedback mechanisms that measure learning and application rather than participation alone.
    • Coach other trainers and subject-matter experts to ensure consistency, accuracy, strong pedagogy, and an inclusive learner experience.
  • Technical advisory and institutional data-capacity strengthening
    • Work with state and central government partners, civil society organisations, and other institutions to diagnose data-system and analytical-capacity gaps.
    • Translate partner needs into feasible technical assistance plans, including data-quality protocols, documentation standards, reporting frameworks, analytical workflows, and capacity-building roadmaps.
    • Advise partners on strengthening data collection, metadata, data dictionaries, codebooks, validation rules, reproducible analysis, and responsible data-sharing practices.
    • Support partners to move from one-off analysis towards institutionalised routines for monitoring, learning, and evidence-informed decision-making.
    • Coordinate with J-PAL s research and policy teams to identify data assets and problem statements that may support future research or evaluation opportunities.
  • Programme and partnership management
    • Manage multiple training and advisory engagements end to end, including scoping, work planning, staffing, contracting, delivery, risk management, reporting, and close-out.
    • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior government officials, donors, universities, technical partners, and civil society organisations.
    • Ensure programmes are responsive to partner needs while maintaining J-PAL s standards for technical quality and ethical data use.
    • Represent the Training vertical in external meetings, workshops, and ecosystem convenings.
  • Learning, knowledge management, and evidence of programme effectiveness
    • Develop monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks for data-capacity programmes, tracking learning gains, application of skills, institutional adoption, and improvements in data practices.
    • Create and maintain reusable repositories of curricula, code examples, teaching datasets, templates, case studies, and delivery guidance.
    • Lead the production of practical briefs, case notes, playbooks, and donor-facing learning products that document what works in strengthening institutional data capacity.
    • Use learner and partner feedback to continuously improve programme design and delivery.
  • Team leadership and organisational contribution
    • Supervise, mentor, and support Training Associates, Senior Training Associates, consultants as the need may be.
    • Set clear goals and quality standards, review technical outputs, and support the professional development of team members.
    • Contribute to financial and operational management, grant reporting, recruitment, and cross-vertical organisational initiatives.
    • Promote a collaborative culture that combines technical rigour, practical problem-solving, and strong partner orientation.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Master s degree in economics, statistics, data science, computer science and AI, engineering or a related quantitative or social science field.
  • For Manager: at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. For Senior Manager: typically 7 or more years of relevant experience, including substantial programme or team leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience using data for public policy, monitoring and evaluation, social-impact programmes, government advisory, or applied research.
  • Strong applied data-analysis skills and proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as R, or Python; working knowledge of SQL is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with large, messy, or administrative datasets, including data cleaning, validation, documentation, analysis, and visualisation.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts, research workflows, and the role of administrative data in evidence-informed decision-making.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, curricula, or advisory services for adult learners.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, budgets, and external relationships.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel within India.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working directly with state or central government departments, public data systems, multilaterals, or large-scale social programmes.
  • Experience developing data pipelines, reusable code libraries, dashboards, automated reporting workflows, or data-quality systems.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, ethical data use, data-sharing agreements, and responsible use of sensitive administrative data.
  • Knowledge of causal inference, impact evaluation, survey design, sampling, or identification strategies.
  • Experience using geospatial data, machine learning, cloud-based analytical environments, or business-intelligence tools in applied development settings.
  • Experience developing open-source curricula, technical manuals, operational toolkits, or knowledge products.
  • Prior experience with fundraising, grant management, donor reporting, or partnership development.
  • Fluency in Hindi.
Core Competencies:
  • Technical depth with practical judgement: Strong understanding and expertise in data governance in governments and other partners; Applies strong analytical skills to real institutional problems and selects tools appropriate to the context.
  • Pedagogical leadership: Designs rigorous, accessible, and practice-oriented learning experiences for diverse adult learners.
  • Institutional capacity building: Looks beyond one-off training to strengthen systems, routines, documentation, and organisational ownership on data governance.
  • Partner orientation: Builds trust, listens carefully, and co-creates solutions that are technically sound and operationally feasible.
  • Operational excellence: Plans and delivers complex programmes with attention to quality, timelines, budgets, and risk.
  • Communication: Explains technical ideas clearly and produces high-quality written, visual, and oral outputs.
  • People leadership: Sets clear expectations, gives constructive feedback, and supports the growth of a diverse team.
  • Mission alignment: Demonstrates a strong commitment to evidence-informed policy and the responsible use of data for social good
Work Authorisation:
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in India.
Application:
  • Interested candidates should submit a CV and cover letter describing their relevant experience in applied data work, capacity building, and stakeholder management. Candidates may be asked to complete a technical and/or teaching exercise as part of the selection process.

title: Solutions Engineer
jobDescription:
The Solutions Engineer is a customer-facing technical partner who works closely with Sales to help prospective customers understand, evaluate, and successfully validate Bolster s platform. This role combines technical expertise, strong communication skills, and a consultative approach to uncover customer needs, demonstrate relevant capabilities, and guide customers through technical evaluations.

The Solutions Engineer supports the sales cycle from technical discovery through solution validation, including product demonstrations, proof-of-value engagements, integrations, and technical due diligence. This role also serves as an important connection between customers and Bolster s Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams by sharing feedback and helping ensure a smooth transition from evaluation to adoption.

Location: Remote (U.S. only)

Work Authorization: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas or provide employment-based immigration support for this position now or in the future.
Key Responsibilities
  • Partner with Account Executives as the primary technical resource throughout the sales process, from discovery through technical validation and close.
  • Conduct technical discovery to understand customer environments, security challenges, workflows, integration requirements, and success criteria.
  • Translate customer requirements into solutions using Bolster s platform and capabilities.
  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations, technical presentations, and workshops tailored to customer use cases and priorities.
  • Plan and execute proof-of-value engagements, including defining scope and success criteria, configuring the solution, troubleshooting technical issues, and presenting results.
  • Help customers understand deployment requirements, APIs, integrations, data flows, authentication, and other technical considerations.
  • Address technical questions and objections throughout the evaluation process and clearly communicate Bolster s capabilities and differentiators.
  • Partner with Customer Success to support a smooth handoff from pre-sales evaluation to implementation and adoption.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to communicate customer feedback, product requirements, and technical challenges identified during sales engagements.
  • Develop and maintain reusable technical resources, including demo environments, integration examples, technical documentation, and enablement materials.
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, competitive solutions, and evolving customer requirements related to digital risk and online fraud.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Security Engineering, or a related customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience supporting SaaS, cybersecurity, or other technical solutions in enterprise customer environments.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and technologies, preferably including digital risk protection, phishing, brand impersonation, threat intelligence, external attack surface management, or related disciplines.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to quickly learn products, APIs, integrations, and customer environments.
  • Experience delivering product demonstrations and conducting technical evaluations or proof-of-value engagements.
  • Ability to translate technical capabilities into customer outcomes and business value.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and work collaboratively with internal teams to identify solutions.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer evaluations and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative approach and experience working with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
$100,000 - $250,000 a year
This range reflects the anticipated base salary for candidates hired to work in California. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, education, geographic location (where applicable), and business needs. This position may also be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Bolster is redefining fraud and brand protection. Our AI-driven SaaS platform detects and takes down phishing and scam sites in real time, protecting the world s top brands and millions of consumers.
Our culture values collaboration, curiosity, and ownership - every team member has a voice and an impact. We believe in building elegant, scalable solutions while maintaining a spirit of experimentation and fun.
Learn more about our cultural values: bolster.ai/about-us

-Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance
-Flexible time off + paid holidays.
-Equity + 401(k) plan

title: District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
jobDescription:
Designation- District Coordinator - Rural Growth Hub
Programme- Strengthening Indias Agricultural Transformation- Rural Growth Hub Pilots
Reporting To- PMU Lead
Engagement Type- Fixed-term Employment
Locations (One Position for Each Location)- Bachhwara, Begusarai (Bihar) | Pallahara, Angul (Odisha) | Maregaon, Yavatmal (Maharashtra) | Indora, Kangra (Himachal Pradesh)

Vision for the Role
Athena Infonomics is supporting the NITI Aayog in the design and implementation of the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) programme- a three-year field engagement demonstrating how integrated, convergence-led agricultural transformation can be achieved at the village cluster level. The programme operates across five states - Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha, Maharashtra, and Himachal Pradesh- with one pilot district and one focus block per state.
The RGH is the operational centrepiece of this engagement. It brings together government schemes, frontier technologies, community institutions, and market linkages within a single village cluster as mutually reinforcing components of a coherent local development system. Rather than adding another layer to an already crowded programme landscape, the RGH works through what already exists: mapping farmers to schemes they are eligible for but not accessing, embedding technologies within existing government delivery channels, and strengthening the capacity of frontline officials to coordinate more effectively. The programme sits within a broader national architecture. PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana (PM-DDKY) provide a reference framework for scheme convergence across 100 aspirational agricultural districts that RGH could learn from and inform. The upcoming Rural Prosperity and Resilience Programme (RPRP) is expected to provide a future financing pathway for scaling what the RGH pilots demonstrate.


The District Coordinator is Athenas single point of contact at the district and focus block level across all concerned departments. This is the role of the primary field intelligence anchor - someone sufficiently embedded in the district and block ecosystem to understand what is happening in practice, what are the opportunities for convergence and what needs to be enabled to make it happen, and how the RGH model can credibly strengthen farmer, village, and block-level outcomes. The District Coordinators ground-level judgement and documentation are the raw material from which the programme learns.


What You Will Own
  • Ground-level intelligence: a current, granular understanding of the agricultural and rural livelihoods landscape in your district and focus block - going beyond administrative data to understand what is happening in practice, how frontline officials are operating, and where scheme intent diverges from farmer experience, existing adoption level of technologies and the market for such services.
  • District and block action plan engagement: systematic gathering and analysis of the District Agriculture and Allied Activities Plan (DAAP) and block-level action plans wherever they exist, and contribution to the design of the Village Cluster Agriculture Action Plan (VCAAP) - the shared planning instrument anchoring the RGH cluster.
  • Intervention mapping, validation, and orchestration: a comprehensive, honest assessment of all active interventions in the focus block - government schemes, technology pilots, and civil society activities - evaluating what is working for which farmer profiles and documenting clearly where it is not. The role is primarily to inform the larger orchestration efforts towards matchmaking, prioritisations, additional activities to amplify impact by different stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder interface: Establish and manager primary working relationship with the District Collectors, District and Block Agriculture / Horticulture Officers, BDO, DPM-RL, Village Pradhans, Panchayat Secretaries, CRPs, KVK staff, and NRLM field functionaries - convening cluster coordination meetings and tracking scheme enrolment, delivery timelines, and institutional bottlenecks. The role also requires engagement with officials at the state level on areas where state level institutions, infrastructure and digital initiatives could be leveraged for scale up.
  • Technical and process documentation: weekly field observation logs, structured farmer feedback records, convergence opportunity matrices, technology adoption data, and monthly field intelligence reports - the mechanism through which ground-level learning becomes evidence that shapes programme adaptation and national policy.

Key Responsibilities

Scheme convergence and farmer-level mapping
  • Map every farmer in the RGH cluster to their current scheme enrolment status, eligibility gaps, and access barriers, building a convergence opportunity matrix per farmer profile and season. Build a strong and contextual understanding of focus schemes including underlying issues and challenges, areas for improvement etc.
  • Coordinate with block and district line department officers to unlock scheme access for eligible farmers, with particular attention to women farmers, SHG members, and marginal landholders. Track progress weekly against the programme target of a minimum of five schemes per farmer in the cluster.
Frontier technology assessment and deployment support
  • Assess existing frontier technology deployments in the focus block - drones, AI advisory systems, soil health tools, precision irrigation, digital crop surveys - evaluating adoption rates, farmer experience, and input efficiency outcomes.
  • Support identification and validation of additional technologies to be layered on existing interventions if any, ensuring they are embedded within government delivery systems and that data collection protocols meet programme standards.
Ground intelligence and field reporting
  • Maintain weekly field observation logs and prepare monthly field intelligence reports synthesising what is working, what is not, and what course corrections are needed.
  • Oversee conduction of structured farmer feedback sessions at the midline and endline, contributing to the programmes baseline-midline-endline survey framework and the generation of outcome data on farm income, yield, input costs, and market access.
  • Travel between the District Headquarters and Blocks as needed with a focus on project outputs and outcomes rather than activities.
Data systems and Shared Data Map maintenance
  • Maintain and update the Shared Data Map - the field-level data convergence instrument to ensure clarity on what data systems, parameters exist including information on data quality, validation status etc.
Community institution strengthening
  • Engage with SHG leads and KVK extension staff to assess the institutional capacity of community organisations around collective scheme enrolment, market linkage, and technology adoption and identify areas of support.

Additional Responsibilities

In addition to responsibilities under the Rural Growth Hub (RGH) Project, the selected candidate will be expected to support and contribute to other ongoing projects, assignments, and initiatives undertaken by Athena Infonomics in the state, as and when required. Such responsibilities may include project planning, stakeholder coordination, data collection and analysis, reporting, field implementation support, and any other tasks aligned with the candidates role, skills, and organizational priorities.

Who We Think You Are
You are likely to have between six and ten years of experience working at district /block / state level in agriculture, rural development, livelihoods, or related fields. You may have come through a social enterprise, an NGO, a government programme implementation role, a development consultancy, or a technology-for-development organisation. What matters most is whether you have spent substantive time at the district level collaborating with frontline officials, community institutions, and farmer households - and whether you understand how government actually works in the states where this programme operates.


You are genuinely curious about why things do not work. When a scheme is not reaching farmers, you want to understand the precise point at which it breaks down. You do not accept low awareness as a sufficient explanation. You have the patience to sit with a Block Agriculture Officer or a Panchayat Secretary and understand their actual operating constraints, not their official account of them. You write clearly - field reports that are honest about what did not work, specific about why, and clear about what it implies. You are at ease in a programme designed to learn and adapt rather than to deliver a fixed model.


WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO BRING
  • A postgraduate qualification in agriculture, rural development, public policy, economics, social work, or a related discipline is the minimum educational requirement.
  • Between six and ten years of work experience, with at least three years in a district or block-level role in agriculture, rural livelihoods, or a related programme.
  • Direct prior experience of working with state government departments - particularly those relevant to agriculture, rural development, and livelihoods - in the state of the district you are applying for. This is a requirement, not a preference.
  • Demonstrated experience of working across a multi-stakeholder ecosystem comprising government line departments, self-help groups, civil society organisations, and private sector service providers.
  • Working familiarity with at least one government scheme MIS or data system - e.g., the NRLM portal, PM-KISAN, PM KUSUM, PMKSY, PM-DDKY, PMFBY, AgriStack, or equivalent - at an operational level.
  • Strong written communication skills in English and in the native language of the district of posting.
  • Exposure to frontier technologies in agriculture is an advantage, though not a prerequisite.

What Athena Offers
The District Coordinator role sits at the most consequential part of Athenas work - the point at which research, policy, and technology meet the reality of a farmers field. The programme is a national engagement with NITI Aayog, supported by a leading philanthropic organisation, and designed to generate evidence that informs how India approaches agricultural transformation at scale. The field intelligence you produce will feed directly into the formulation and design of the RGH models across the focus blocks.

You will work closely with the central PMU team at NITI Aayog and Athena s Core Project Team, with regular structured feedback and cross-district learning cycles built into the programme design. Athena is investing in building its agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice into a substantive national and international portfolio. For the right candidate, this role offers a genuine pathway into a growing organisation that values people who understand what is happening on the ground.

  • Competitive compensation benchmarked to development sector norms for district-level technical roles.
  • Travel support for district and block-level field visits and quarterly cross-district learning sessions.
  • Access to Athenas central research, data, and technology capabilities, including the APLYD AI and digital public infrastructure unit and the TolaData impact monitoring platform.
  • Structured mentorship from the central PMU team, with opportunities to growth within Athenas agriculture, climate, and livelihoods practice. [1]

Application Requirements
Please note that the selected candidates would be stationed at the identified block within the district with frequent travel to the District Headquarter.
  • Updated CV - not exceeding three pages.
  • A covering note (maximum four hundred words) on: which block you are applying for, your most relevant prior experience, and one observation from your field experience that you believe is underappreciated in how agricultural programmes are designed or how frontier technologies could witness accelerated adoption in the country.

Athena Infonomics is an Equal Opportunities Employer

Athena Infonomics is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, or disability status.


This is not a guarantee or right bestowed upon the candidate but simply an opportunity to examine growth based on vacancy, performance during the period of engagement and mutual agreement.

descriptionFromApi:
Idera, Inc. delivers B2B software productivity tools that enable technical users to do more with less, faster. Idera, Inc. brands span three divisions-Database Tools, Developer Tools, and Testing Tools-with products evangelized by millions of community members and more than 50,000 customers worldwide, including some of the worlds largest healthcare, financial services, retail, and technology companies.

Job Details
Come join Ideras Corporate Accounting Organization as a Global Accounts Receivable Manager;. We are looking for creative problem solvers to join our team and revolutionize the way the world does business. If youre a sharp, intellectually curious thinker who thrives on ambiguity and can juggle multiple shifting priorities without missing a beat, we want to hear from you. Ideras Finance team drives business growth and profitability through strategic, financial and operational leadership.

Position Summary
Idera is seeking a Global Accounts Receivable Manager to lead collections strategy and execution across a global portfolio of software businesses. This role is responsible for improving cash collections, reducing delinquency, strengthening end-to-end accounts receivable operations, and driving consistency across processes, systems, and controls throughout the order-to-cash cycle. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong business-to-business software collections experience, sound business judgment, the creativity to devise practical solutions to problems that dont come with a playbook, and the ability to operate effectively in a multi-entity environment. Reporting to the Vice President of Accounting, this person will partner closely with Billing, Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Legal, Treasury, and business-unit leadership to resolve disputes, improve processes, support scalable growth, and enhance the customer payment experience. The role requires strong Microsoft Excel skills to analyze aging, identify trends, reconcile activity, and provide actionable insights to leadership.

What You ll Do
- Lead day-to-day collections operations across a portfolio of domestic and international customer
accounts, while partnering across teams that support billing, cash application, credits, and receivables
reconciliations.
- Develop and execute collection strategies that improve cash flow, reduce past-due balances, and
support company DSO and bad debt objectives.
- Monitor AR aging, delinquency trends, unapplied cash, deductions, dispute activity, and payment
behavior; prioritize collection efforts based on risk, customer profile, and materiality.
- Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Billing, Revenue Operations, and Legal to resolve invoice
disputes, short pays, contract interpretation issues, billing discrepancies, and other barriers to collection
to resolve escalations and improve upstream processes that affect collectability.
- Serve as an escalation point for complex or high-value customer accounts and drive timely resolution
while maintaining strong business relationships.
- Support strong billing-to-cash execution by helping ensure invoices, credits, refunds, amendments,
and customer account maintenance are handled accurately and in alignment with contracts, ERP
records, and billing platforms.
- Establish and maintain collection policies, workflows, escalation paths, SOPs, and operating
procedures that support a scalable and consistent process across business units.
- Prepare recurring and ad hoc reporting on AR aging, collections performance, cash collections,
dispute trends, bad debt exposure, and portfolio health; provide KPI and forecast visibility to Finance
leadership.
- Lead and develop the accounts receivable team through hiring, training, motivating, evaluating, and
supervising, including structured coaching, individual development plans, and performance
documentation that build bench strength for future growth.
- Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve collections, cash application, dispute
management, and reporting workflows. Actively evaluate and adopt AI-enabled tools to strengthen
decision-making, surface risk earlier, and increase team productivity.
- Support credit risk assessment for new and existing accounts, including credit checks and credit limit
recommendations, in partnership with Sales and Finance leadership.
- Support monthly and quarterly close activities related to accounts receivable, reserves,
reconciliations, subledger accuracy, and reporting.
- Ensure accurate account documentation, customer follow-up history, and audit-ready support within
ERP, CRM, ticketing, and billing systems.

- Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent
practical experience.
- 7+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing, collections, or order-to-cash
functions.
- 3+ years of experience leading collections teams, AR operations, or multi-account portfolios in a
business-to-business environment.
- Experience in a software, SaaS, or technology-driven company.
- Strong understanding of end-to-end AR operations, including billing, collections, cash application,
credits, reconciliations, and dispute resolution.
- Strong understanding of collections strategy, AR aging, customer account risk, and general
accounting fundamentals.
- Experience partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Billing, Revenue Operations,
and other business stakeholders.
- Experience preparing AR reporting, KPI metrics, cash collection insights, and executive-ready
presentations.
- Strong written and verbal communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to manage
customer conversations professionally and handle escalations effectively.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced
environment with a proven ability to multitask across competing deadlines without losing accuracy or
attention to detail.
- Experience with ERP, billing, and CRM platforms such as NetSuite, Intacct, Microsoft

jobDescription:
JOB ID: QT-KRS-08-513
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Technical Architect with strong expertise in Azure AI, Agentic AI, RAG, LangGraph/LangChain, Python, and enterprise architecture . The ideal candidate will lead the technical architecture and delivery across multiple engineering tracks, ensuring scalable integrations, robust observability, security, and enterprise-grade AI solutions.
The candidate should have strong hands-on experience designing agentic AI systems , RAG architectures , Azure-based solutions, and backend platforms while coordinating teams across backend, LLM/AI, frontend, and data engineering disciplines.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define, implement, and enforce architectural standards, integration patterns, data contracts, and engineering best practices across all delivery tracks.
  • Lead weekly technical steering calls with Product Owners and technical stakeholders.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve cross-track dependencies and shared infrastructure decisions.
  • Drive architectural decisions related to:
    • ServiceNow client libraries and integrations
    • PostgreSQL schema and data models
    • Scheduler and workflow design
    • API integration patterns
    • Shared infrastructure and platform components
  • Review and approve LangGraph/LangChain agent designs , RAG architectures, API integration approaches, and data models before development begins.
  • Design scalable and reliable Agentic AI architectures for enterprise use cases.
  • Define and govern RAG pipelines , including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval strategies, vector databases, reranking, and response generation.
  • Architect and review Azure-based solutions using services such as Azure Resource Graph, Azure Monitor, Azure Advisor, AKS, and Azure Container Apps .
  • Ensure strong implementation of OpenTelemetry, observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, and metrics across applications and AI workflows.
  • Manage technical risks, identify blockers, escalate critical issues, and own the technical change request process.
  • Conduct code reviews and architecture reviews at monthly milestone gates.
  • Ensure adherence to security, compliance, access control, and enterprise governance requirements.
  • Define observability standards for AI agents, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems.
  • Mentor and coordinate engineers across Backend, LLM/AI, Frontend, DevOps, and Data Engineering teams.
  • Produce monthly milestone completion reports, technical documentation, architecture documents, and handover documentation.
  • Communicate complex technical architecture and design decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mandatory Skills Agentic AI & Generative AI
  • Strong hands-on experience with Agentic AI architecture and development .
  • Strong experience designing and implementing AI agents using LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks .
  • Strong understanding of multi-agent systems, agent workflows, tool calling, memory, planning, and orchestration.
  • Strong experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture and implementation.
  • Experience with embeddings, vector databases, document processing, chunking strategies, retrieval optimization, reranking, and LLM integration.
  • Strong knowledge of LLM application architecture, prompt engineering, AI evaluation, and guardrails.
Azure AI & Cloud
  • Strong Azure AI experience is mandatory.
  • Deep knowledge of Azure cloud architecture and enterprise Azure services.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Azure Resource Graph
    • Azure Monitor
    • Azure Advisor
    • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
    • Azure Container Apps
  • Experience designing scalable, secure, and highly available cloud-native applications.
Backend & Data
  • Strong Python backend development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI and asynchronous programming patterns.
  • Strong understanding of API architecture and RESTful services.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL , database schema design, and data modeling.
  • Experience designing scalable backend services and enterprise integrations.
Observability
  • Strong observability experience is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding and implementation experience with OpenTelemetry .
  • Experience with distributed tracing, structured logging, metrics, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Ability to design observability frameworks for distributed applications, microservices, APIs, and AI/agent workflows.
Enterprise Integration
  • Strong experience integrating with ServiceNow REST APIs in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience defining API contracts, integration patterns, authentication, authorization, and error-handling strategies.
  • Experience managing shared infrastructure and cross-system dependencies.
Required Experience
  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise software engineering.
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in a Technical Lead, Solution Architect, or Technical Architect role.
  • Experience delivering enterprise-scale projects for large clients in a consulting or managed services environment .
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong ability to make architecture decisions and manage technical risks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to explain complex architecture and AI concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Nagios, or SolarWinds .
  • Familiarity with DevBrewry or similar FinOps platforms .
  • Experience with Backstage.io or Internal Developer Portals.
  • Knowledge of ITIL and ITSM frameworks .
  • Experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and Azure governance.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps, Kubernetes, and cloud-native security practices.
Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on Technical Architect who combines strong enterprise software architecture experience with deep expertise in Azure AI, Agentic AI, RAG, LangGraph/LangChain, Python, OpenTelemetry, and observability . The candidate should be capable of driving end-to-end technical decisions, governing multiple engineering tracks, mentoring technical teams, and delivering secure and scalable AI solutions for large enterprise clients.
Key Mandatory Keywords
